description: This is a Java source test file for the class SimpleDosingInstructions, containing unit tests verifying validation logic, date calculations, and concept mapping for drug orders within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: SimpleDosingInstructionsTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the validation, date calculation, and concept mapping logic of the SimpleDosingInstructions class within the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfAutoExpireDateIsNotSetAndDurationUnitsIsNotMappedToSNOMEDCTDuration
methods.description: Tests validation failure when autoExpireDate is null and durationUnits are not properly mapped.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAutoExpireDateIsSetAndDurationUnitsIsNotMappedToSNOMEDCTDuration
methods.description: Tests validation passes when autoExpireDate is set even if durationUnits are not mapped.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAutoExpireDateAndDurationUnitsAreNotSet
methods.description: Tests validation passes when both autoExpireDate and durationUnits are null.

methods.name: getAutoExpireDate_shouldInferAutoExpireDateForAKnownSNOMEDCTDurationUnit
methods.description: Verifies autoExpireDate inference for known SNOMED CT duration units.

methods.name: getAutoExpireDate_shouldInferAutoExpireDateForScheduledDrugOrder
methods.description: Verifies autoExpireDate calculation for scheduled drug orders.

methods.name: getAutoExpireDate_shouldInferAutoExpireDateIfDurationIsSet
methods.description: Verifies autoExpireDate when duration and duration units are set.

methods.name: getAutoExpireDate_shouldNotInferAutoExpireDateWhenDurationDoesNotExist
methods.description: Ensures no autoExpireDate is inferred if duration is null.

methods.name: getAutoExpireDate_shouldNotInferAutoExpireDateWhenDurationUnitsDoesNotExist
methods.description: Ensures no autoExpireDate is inferred if durationUnits is null.

methods.name: getAutoExpireDate_shouldNotInferAutoExpireDateWhenConceptMappingOfSourceSNOMEDCTDurationDoesNotExist
methods.description: Verifies no autoExpireDate when concept mapping is missing or invalid.

methods.name: createValidDrugOrder
methods.description: Helper method to create a valid DrugOrder object with predefined properties for testing.

methods.name: createConceptWithName
methods.description: Creates a Concept object with the specified name.

methods.name: createUnits
methods.description: Creates a Concept representing measurement units, mapped via concept codes.
